newsitem.title: USA: Cherry Corp opens Mexican facility.
newsitem.headline: Cherry Corp opens Mexican facility.

text.p: Cherry Corp said Monday it established an operation in Juarez, Mexico, conducted through a wholly owned subsidiary, Cherry de Mexico, SA de CV.
Prior to this, Cherry said, it used the services of a contract assembler in the Juarez area.
The new operation is housed in temporary facilities while a new 51,000 square foot building is being constructed. The new facility is scheduled for completion in early September, it added.
Initially, approximately 120 employees will be employed by the new operation to assemble both automotive and snap-action switches.
Cherry manufactures electrical switches, sensors, electronic keyboards and displays, and semiconductors.
